info.name: MedConsults CRM API
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for MedConsults CRM backend covering Auth, Users, Doctors, Patients, and Audit Logs.

request.description: Registers a doctor with pending approval status.
Consumes single-use verification token to mark user emailVerified = true.
Resends verification email, enforcing 60s per-user cooldown.
Authenticates user, sets HttpOnly refresh token cookie, returns access JWT.
Rotates refresh token and issues a new access token.
Clears session refresh token cookie and invalidates session hash in database.
Dispatches password reset email if account exists. Generic 200 response.
Consumes reset token, updates password, and revokes all active sessions.
Retrieves the authenticated user's own profile.
Updates the logged-in user's own name and phone number.
Admin endpoint to search and paginate all users in the clinic.
Creates staff or admin user, creates a password reset token, and dispatches invitation email.
Updates user details. Administrators cannot demote themselves.
Blocks user and revokes all active sessions. Admin cannot block themselves.
Unblocks a user account, restoring access.
Public directory of approved doctors with live online status. Never exposes email or phone.
Public profile details of a single approved doctor.
Computes free appointment slots in Asia/Kolkata timezone, excluding booked and blocked times.
Doctor retrieves own profile and schedule settings.
Doctor updates bio, fee, qualifications, and room.
Doctor updates weekly availability schedule and slot durations.
Doctor toggles active clinic presence.
Doctor client updates lastSeenAt timestamp.
Admin endpoint to view all doctors across all approval statuses with linked user info.
Admin retrieves list of doctors awaiting approval.
Approves doctor profile and activates doctor's user account.
Blocks doctor and linked user account, revoking active sessions.
Retrieves the authenticated patient's own CRM record.
Staff/Admin searches and lists patient CRM records.
Creates a CRM patient record without credentials, assigning unique patientCode.
Retrieves patient details. Allowed for Staff, Admin, and treating Doctors with an appointment.
Retrieves interaction timeline for a patient.
Updates contact and CRM details of a patient.
Soft deletes patient record. Restricted to administrators.
Admin endpoint to inspect security and administrative audit log trail.

request.description: Public website enquiry endpoint with rate limiting (5/hr/IP) and honeypot spam protection.
Retrieves paginated leads list with stage, source, owner, date range, and text search filtering.
Returns Kanban board grouped by stage with count per stage and the newest 20 cards per column.
Creates a new CRM sales lead. Normalizes Indian phone numbers automatically.
Fetches single lead details with assigned owner and patient links.
Updates lead contact info, interest, source, or assigned owner.
Moves lead across stages. Moving to 'lost' requires 'lostReason'. Records activity.
Converts lead into Patient CRM record, linking by phone/email or creating new patient. Converting twice returns 409.
Soft deletes lead record. Restricted to administrators.
Books an appointment slot. Requires verified email for patients. Issues token number and appointmentCode.
Role-scoped listing of appointments. Staff receives reception view; admin responses omit reason.
Counts appointments per status for a specific date in Asia/Kolkata timezone.
Registers a walk-in patient at clinic reception. Issues next queue token without consuming calendar slots.
Returns full appointment details. Enforces ownership (404 for unauthorized users). Reason is omitted for admin.
Reschedules an appointment to a new slot. Patients must reschedule > 2 hours ahead. Issues new token.
Cancels an appointment and frees slot. Patients must cancel > 2 hours ahead.
Staff/Admin check-in on the scheduled appointment date.
Doctor or Admin starts consultation. Enforces only one active in_consultation per doctor at a time (409).
Treating doctor completes consultation and closes OPD session.
Marks appointment as no-show after scheduled start time.
Live queue for today ordered by in_consultation, checked_in tokens, booked, and finished, with wait times.
